# Kerem Özdemir

> Sustainability and economics, Munich. Products, instruments, case studies, simulations and games that run in the browser. English, Turkish and German.

Everything on this site is static and runs on the page; nothing is uploaded and no third party is called.

## Portfolio
- [Products](https://keremozdemir.de/projects/): plsfix, Frons, LiveOps economy engine, Agent Gateway, CoLaunch
- [Instruments](https://keremozdemir.de/work/instruments/): CBAM, embedded emissions, reduction pathways, provenance, analyst
- [Case studies](https://keremozdemir.de/cases/): eight, each with the method, the assumptions and what it refuses to answer
- [Tools](https://keremozdemir.de/work/workshop/): nine single-job tools with 466 hand-written checks
- [Simulations](https://keremozdemir.de/work/simulations/): segregation, diffusion, jam, pile, recommender
- [Economics](https://keremozdemir.de/work/economics/): lemons, tax incidence, discounting, cooperation
- [Games](https://keremozdemir.de/games/): a film, a walkable 3D edition of the site, six games of strategy
- [Notes](https://keremozdemir.de/notes/)
